title: Piercing all maximum cliques in hypergraphs
summary: Graphs whose maximum clique size exceeds half of the total number of vertices satisfy a classical property: the family of their maximum sized cliques can be pierced by a single vertex. This result dates back to a 1965 theorem by Hajnal. Motivated by this theorem, Jung, Keszegh, Pálvölgyi, and Yuditsky recently conjectured that an analogous result should hold for hypergraphs of larger uniformity, with an appropriate constant replacing the threshold $1/2$.
